column7: INVARIANT-GUARDS-1 observation 4: writeAuditEventFailed built its event (actorTypeFromContext, impersonatorFromContext) before emitAudit's recover began, so a panic during construction escaped to a deny path or post-commit step whose answer was already decided. It now defers besteffort.RunRecover; red on main for the construction panic (a storage-write panic was already recovered by emitAudit and is kept as a regression pin). The family guard internal/core/guards TestAuditEventWritersRecoverTheirOwnPanic holds every core AuditEvent builder to the rule: six more best-effort writers got RunRecover, the audit-before-disclosure writers are exempt with a reason (a recover would return nil and disclose unaudited), the two impersonation.go writers stay OPEN for FIX-3277.
